source: make me a game that's like tiktok in which you can scroll through user generated videos for example: "somone completing a obby" make the ui able to be clicked off of and re opened by a phone icon in the bottom middle of the screen make the map fully made of grass with interactive building interiors and a fountain with a path which goes around the entire map in the middle which Is where spawn will be

image_prompt.text: A decorative fountain at the dead centre of the map, composed to be the thing you see first and navigate by
Spawn at the fountain in the middle of the map, oriented so the first shot is the fountain and the ring path around it
the entire map surfaced in grass
a paved path running in a full circle around the middle of the map
buildings set around the path with interiors players can walk into and interact with

layout_placement.text: The spawn point itself, placed at the fountain in the centre of the ring path
Small optional finds tucked away off the main path for players who explore

notes: P3 was added by hand: the prompt asks for interactive building interiors and Entertainment has no interior option, so the outside-to-inside cost would otherwise be invisible.
The Entertainment file routes the Video subgenre to P5 as a consumption surface, but this prompt specifies a real map to walk around while scrolling, so it was built rather than refused.
The video feed and the phone icon that toggles it are the actual game and are entirely screen-space.

open_questions.ask: Grass, a fountain and a ring path could be a manicured park or a rural green - which look do you want?
How far around is the ring path - a garden you cross in seconds, or a walk of a minute or two?
How many buildings, and what are they - houses, shops, something else?

coverage_missing.ask: How large is the map inside the ring path?
How many buildings and what type?
Is there anything to do outdoors besides walk around and watch videos?

answers.ask: Grass, a fountain and a ring path could be a manicured park or a rural green - which look do you want?
answers.answer: Use a manicured park look: bright grass, a clean central fountain, and a neat paved ring path.

answers.ask: How far around is the ring path - a garden you cross in seconds, or a walk of a minute or two?
answers.answer: Make it a small garden-sized map that players can cross in seconds; keep the ring path compact around the central spawn fountain.

answers.ask: How many buildings, and what are they - houses, shops, something else?
answers.answer: Use a small set of interactive buildings around the path: two houses and two simple shops, each with an accessible interior.
